newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 2.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 2.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had one large one day net miss in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The miss, which occurred on Tuesday, was due to fewer reserves than anticipated in the banking system because federal reserve depostis were much higher than expected.
The high in natural float was about $5.3 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $1.8 billion on Friday.
Transportation float averaged a bit under $375 million per day, with the high on Tuesday at about $2.0 billion primarily due to fog in the Cleveland, Dallas and Chicago areas.
